description: This file performs database migrations and updates between versions 5.2.1 and 5.3.0RC of the vtiger CRM system. It includes schema modifications, data updates, and configuration setup routines necessary for the system upgrade, such as updating entity fields, adding new tables, registering webservice entities, and adjusting module configurations.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents Webservice entity objects, used for registering and querying web service entities.

classes.name: Vtiger_Module
classes.description: Represents a module in vtiger, used here for adding blocks and fields.

classes.name: Vtiger_Block
classes.description: Represents a block in a module where fields are added.

classes.name: Vtiger_Field
classes.description: Represents a field in a module or block, used for creating new fields and setting properties.

classes.name: UserTimeZones
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving supported user time zones.

methods.name: vt530_addEmailFieldTypeInWs
methods.description: Adds 'email' as a new field type in the webservice field types table if not already present.

methods.name: vt530_addFilterToListTypes
methods.description: Adds a 'listtypes' operation parameter to the webservice operation if not already set.

methods.name: vt530_registerVTEntityDeltaApi
methods.description: Registers event handlers 'vtiger.entity.beforesave' and 'vtiger.entity.aftersave' for delta processing.

methods.name: vt530_addDependencyColumnToEventHandler
methods.description: Ensures the 'dependent_on' column exists in 'vtiger_eventhandlers' table.

methods.name: vt530_addDepedencyToVTWorkflowEventHandler
methods.description: Updates event handlers to include dependency information in 'dependent_on' field for 'vtiger.entity.aftersave'.

methods.name: vt530_renameField
methods.description: Renames fields across related tables and updates references in filters, criteria, and reports.

methods.name: vt530_updateCurrencyInfo
methods.description: Deletes existing currencies and inserts updated currency data from external currency definitions.

methods.name: vt530_changeDataType
methods.description: Changes the data type of a specified column in multiple related tables and updates related filter and report configurations.
